values.note: Booked online on Campspot (the site's 'Reserve now' link). Two-night minimum and a $25 surcharge on Darien Lake concert nights (either the night before or after the concert), and a two-night minimum on holidays. Check-in 1 pm (arrange a late check-in after 6 pm; none after 11 pm), check-out noon. $25 cash security deposit at check-in, returned at check-out. Registered camper 21+.

booking.source: https://cherryhillcamp.com/rates-and-regulations/ ('There is a $25 upcharge & two night minimum stay on on Darien Lake concert nights'; 'Check in time-1 pm, check out time-12 noon'; '$25 CASH security deposit'; 'Reserve now' -> https://reservation.campspot.com/cherryhillcamp) + https://cherryhillcamp.com/faqs/ ('On holidays and Darien Lake concert nights we do require two night minimum reservations. You have the flexibility to choose the day before or the day after the concert'; 'Each site must be registered & occupied by someone aged 21 yrs. or older'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Mostly tent sites: Campspot lists 7 'RV-No Hook ups' sites (rigs to 40 ft, 5 of them fit a 23-ft rig; back-in and pull-through) beside 26 tent sites, 4 lean-tos and a cabin. 'Most of our campsites are designed for tent camping, not for parking vehicles.'

summary: Operator site and Campspot: confirmed no hookups (dry camping, quiet inverter generators only), potable water/dump/showers/laundry, booking on Campspot (now manual) with the holiday 2-night minimum; sites max 40 ft now manual from Campspot's RV type (7 RV sites, pull-through).
